title: Deathgrip (errata)
old_text: Kill a friendly unit to give +[M] equal to its Might to another friendly unit this turn. Draw 1.
new_text: Kill a friendly unit. If you do, give +[M] equal to its Might to another friendly unit this turn. Draw 1.
explanation: Friendly unit is a target not a cost. Draw 1 happens regardless.
